recap:
BHA secured a 2-1 victory over MCI. BHA exhibited control against chaos, holding 46.5% possession with 648 passes and an 82.1% accuracy, contrasting with MCI’s 53.5% possession and 737 passes. BHA’s press intensity was managed at a PPDA of 6.5, beating the target of 8.0, while MCI operated at a higher 11.6.

The game plan saw the match remain largely on plan regarding possession (46% vs target 45%) and counter-press regains (25% vs target 24%). However, the defensive line height drifted off plan, falling to 37.4 m against a target of 38.0 m.

The match was defined by high-regain sequences for BHA, including an early high regain at minute 5 leading to a shot opportunity. The turning point arrived at minute 41 with a counter-attack goal for MCI by #9 Gabriel Voss (xG 0.35, 104 km/h), assisted by #11 Yusuf Mensah. BHA responded immediately with a crucial set piece at minute 63. #5 Isaac Kane-Moss scored a header from a corner, securing the second goal (xG 0.37, 51 km/h), assisted by #7 Tomas Calloway.

Running data showed a total distance of 114.1 km, with high-speed movement reaching 8740 m. A deviation occurred at minute 70 when #7 Tomas Calloway ran 29% less than in his first 30'. Later, at minute 75, the shape out of possession shifted to 5-4-1, deviating from the target 4-4-2.
